get_class_weight_from_file: load class weights from a numpy or pkl file path for use in a loss function
reduce_loss_tensor: reduce an elementwise loss tensor using mean, sum, or none reduction strategy
weight_reduce_loss_tensor: apply element-wise weights to a loss tensor and reduce with mean or sum
create_weighted_loss_decorator: decorate an element-wise loss function to support weight and reduction arguments
review_weighted_loss_wrapper: review the weighted_loss decorator that wraps loss functions with weight and reduction support
